Method of Attack: Identifies NetBeans directory and enumerates projects
Embeds malicious payload in project files and build JAR files
Ensures persistence by executing payload during every NetBeans project build
Drops payload and command and control software components into JAR files of other applications
Impacted Systems: Java applications built using infected NetBeans IDE
Attack Vector: Supply chain attack targeting NetBeans IDE
Propagation through build artifacts of infected NetBeans projects
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious payload embedded in project files and build JAR files
Command and control software components dropped into JAR files
